'''Adnah Tiblarett''' was the name of a fictitious [[Artist/Legends|artist]] that [[Marn Hierogryph]] used in his attempt to con [[Dremullar Obohn di Garthos]], the curator of the [[Obohn Gallery of the Industrial Aesthetic]] [[Museum/Legends|museum]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. Hierogryph took the name from a door in the [[Upper City]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
